notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In order to join[b] Steam Next Fest[/b], we have set up a small demo for players

In this demo, you will get familiar with our friend[b] [Camera][/b] and the [b]first apartment[/b] you live in.
This will be your first day in ToDo LisT, but the story is not just about work, The demo content is about[b] 5% [/b]of the full version.
		
We will also update the demo during the fest, for fixing bugs and optimizing the gameplay to the best with our efforts!
